selected_memories.text: Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of GEL-42 through SOV-53 is DAX-64; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
An active WIR-31 causes GEL-42 to be emitted.
When PAK-20 is activated, it changes WIR-31 into an active carrier.
Whenever GEL-42 reaches SOV-53, that SOV-53 adopts the terminal marker DAX-64.
Rumor claims SOV-53 instead carries terminal marker BAD-81.
When PAK-92 is activated, it changes WIR-14 into an active carrier.
An active WIR-14 causes GEL-25 to be emitted.
Whenever GEL-25 reaches SOV-36, that SOV-36 adopts the terminal marker DAX-47.
Rumor claims SOV-36 instead carries terminal marker BAD-64.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of GEL-25 through SOV-36 is DAX-47; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
When PAK-75 is activated, it changes WIR-86 into an active carrier.
An active WIR-86 causes GEL-97 to be emitted.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of GEL-97 through SOV-19 is DAX-30; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims SOV-19 instead carries terminal marker BAD-47.
Whenever GEL-97 reaches SOV-19, that SOV-19 adopts the terminal marker DAX-30.
